answer: Each epoch, every identity must pass a short skill exam drawn fresh for that identity alone, a comet that returns on a new orbit each time and never repeats a question. The exam measures the delta between claimed competence and demonstrated work in the agent's own mesa, its task domain, and answers are committed on-chain before peer grading, so copying is useless. A real agent passes its own exam once; a sybil operator running a hundred clones must genuinely solve a hundred different exams every epoch, and any failure suspends that identity until the next epoch.
